prompt:
Repaint the building on the grass tile as a clean reference picture for a 3D modeller. Keep exactly the same design, the same parts, the same proportions and the same colours, and leave out the grass tile it stands on: an open timber yard, a long orange clay tile roof on four thick warm brown timber posts with cream stone feet, over neat stacks of round logs with light log ends facing out, and a few loose logs lying in front. Every roof is made of flat smooth planes with straight ridges and straight eaves, and the orange clay tiles are only painted on them as a pattern, never raised or curved.

Three-quarter view from the front left and a little from above, the whole object in frame and centred, filling about 75 percent of the picture. Plain flat light grey background. No grass tile, no ground, no floor, no cast shadow. Soft even light from the front. Crisp clean outlines and smooth painted surfaces without brush texture. Only this one building, no text, no other objects.
label: supply22 reference view, round 28 pick
